name: valkey-cli
description: Installs valkey-cli, the Valkey command-line client, from upstream's binary release at an exact version, checked against a sha256 you supply. There are no default pins.

version.description: Valkey version to install, without a leading v (e.g. 9.1.3). Set it with its sha256 here, or as CLI_VALKEY_VERSION in the image environment, or in the pins file. There is no default.

sha256_amd64.description: sha256 of valkey-<version>-noble-x86_64.tar.gz, needed on amd64. Set it here, or as CLI_VALKEY_SHA256_AMD64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

sha256_arm64.description: sha256 of valkey-<version>-noble-arm64.tar.gz, needed on arm64. Set it here, or as CLI_VALKEY_SHA256_ARM64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read when neither the options nor the image environment set a pin. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.
